title: NextLongIso samplesheet
description: Schema for the file provided with --samplesheet. Columns: sample,condition and either fastq (--input_type fastq) or bam (--input_type bam). Additional columns are allowed and can be used as covariates in --design (categorical values following the sample-name rules, or numbers for the columns listed in --numeric_covariates).

sample.errorMessage: Sample names are required, must be unique, must start with a letter or digit and may contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' (regex ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$). Spaces, '/', quotes and other characters are not allowed because sample names are used in file names and shell commands.

condition.errorMessage: Condition is required for every sample, must start with a letter or digit and may contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' (regex ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$). Spaces, '/', quotes and other characters are not allowed because condition names are used in file names and shell commands.

fastq.errorMessage: FASTQ file must exist, must not contain spaces and must end with .fastq, .fq, .fastq.gz or .fq.gz

bam.errorMessage: BAM file must exist, must not contain spaces and must end with .bam
